notes: ① 新增「还原备份」卡（排在「退出后执行」之后、「同步内容」之前）：先显示备份目录，默认 ~\.dsh\backups，点「修改」可改成任意绝对路径（例如 D:\DSH备份），点「恢复默认」清回默认值；配置存在 ~\.dsh\dsh-config-sync.json 的 backupRoot，留空即默认，跟本机走、不进仓库。② 卡片列出该目录下的所有快照：名称、时间、文件数、占用大小。点某一行的「还原」就按那一份生成 <仓库>\同步-还原-<快照名>.cmd（文件名带快照名，多份可并存、互不覆盖）。③ 生成的脚本先打印快照信息，再用 restore.ps1 -BackupDir <该快照> -DryRun 只读预览，输入 y 确认后才真跑；真跑前会把当前状态另存一份 manual-<时间戳>，回退错了还能退回来。完全退出 DSH 后双击即可 —— 和整个插件一致：profile 文件在 DSH 运行时被客户端持有，不在运行中覆盖。④ 只认能用的快照：没有 profile\package.json 的快照（新机器首次拉取时 apply 留下的空快照）标「没有 profile 文件，不能还原」、「不可还原」置灰，宿主也会拒掉这类路径；面板传来的路径必须是备份根之下真实存在的一份快照（越界、相对路径、含引号换行都直接报错）。⑤ runtime\restore.ps1 无需改动：它本来就支持 -BackupDir / -DryRun / -SkipInstall / -WithMnemon，这版只是把「挑哪一份」从命令行搬到面板上。
notesEn: (1) New "Restore backup" card (after "After exit", before "Sync content"): it shows the backup folder first, default ~\.dsh\backups, and "Edit" lets you point it at any absolute path (e.g. D:\DSH-backups); "Use default" clears it back. Stored as backupRoot in ~\\.dsh\\dsh-config-sync.json — empty means the default, kept on this machine and never committed. (2) The card lists every snapshot in that folder: name, time, file count and size. Clicking "Restore" on a row generates <repo>\\同步-还原-<snapshot name>.cmd for exactly that snapshot (several can coexist without overwriting each other). (3) The generated script prints the snapshot info, dry-runs restore.ps1 -BackupDir <that snapshot> -DryRun, and only writes after you type y; before writing it saves the current state as manual-<timestamp> so a wrong rollback can be rolled back again. Quit DSH fully, then double-click — same rule as the rest of the plugin: the profile files are held by the running client, so nothing is overwritten while DSH runs. (4) Only usable snapshots are offered: one without profile\\package.json (the empty snapshot apply leaves on a fresh machine) is labelled "no profile files, cannot restore" with a greyed-out button, and the host rejects such paths too; a path from the panel must be a real snapshot under the backup root (escaping it, relative paths, quotes or newlines are errors). (5) runtime\\restore.ps1 needed no change: it already supports -BackupDir / -DryRun / -SkipInstall / -WithMnemon; this release just moves "which snapshot" from the command line into the panel.
